chain_words.nuance: presents something as smaller or less serious than it really is
makes the truth harder to see without hiding it completely
keeps information hidden from view on purpose
actively prevents information from being published or known
replaces the truth with deliberately false information

explanation: These words all describe hiding the truth, but with increasing severity, from quietly minimising a fact to deliberately inventing a false version of it.

usage_notes.difference: 'Conceal' means keeping information out of sight, while 'suppress' means actively preventing it from being published or known by others.
